facts.fact: The IPDCP says 35 data protection correspondents were designated by their organisations under articles 75 ff of law no. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019, which is therefore being applied.
facts.system: Loi n° 2019-014 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The IPDCP, led by its President Colonel Belei Bediani, opened a training session and is described as the data protection authority of Togo.

The IPDCP ran a three-day training session (22 to 24 June 2026) for 35 data protection correspondents, covering prior formalities, processing registers, impact assessments and breach management, and issued attendance certificates.
